name: Block-based Data Partitioning
definition: Partitioning data using 'blocks' instead of 'cells' as the atomic unit. A block is a 3D rectangular slab of adjacent cells. This reduces storage overhead of the external index structure compared to cell-level indexing.
summary: Block-based Data Partitioning groups 3D cells into rectangular blocks for indexing, reducing storage overhead and improving I/O efficiency at the cost of loading redundant data.
